name: @nonsuch/component-library
description: A Vue 3 component library built on Quasar with opinionated defaults and custom components.

scripts.build: vite build && rm -f tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
